import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_35/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, they would be listed here
    ]

    # Initialize an empty DataFrame to accumulate results
    accumulated_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=['Source Zipcode', 'Counts'])

    for file_path in source_files:
        # Load the source CSV
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Ensure 'Source Zipcode' is integer type (coerce errors to NaN and drop them)
        df['Source Zipcode'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Source Zipcode'], errors='coerce')
        df = df.dropna(subset=['Source Zipcode'])
        df['Source Zipcode'] = df['Source Zipcode'].astype(int)

        # Ensure 'Counts' is integer type (coerce errors to NaN and drop them)
        df['Counts'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Counts'], errors='coerce')
        df = df.dropna(subset=['Counts'])
        df['Counts'] = df['Counts'].astype(int)

        # Group by 'Source Zipcode' and sum 'Counts'
        grouped = df.groupby('Source Zipcode', as_index=False)['Counts'].sum()

        # Append to accumulated_df
        accumulated_df = pd.concat([accumulated_df, grouped], ignore_index=True)

    # After processing all sources, group again to combine counts from all sources
    final_df = accumulated_df.groupby('Source Zipcode', as_index=False)['Counts'].sum()

    # Rename columns to match target schema exactly
    final_df = final_df.rename(columns={'Source Zipcode': 'Source Zipcode', 'Counts': 'Counts'})

    # Save to target CSV
    final_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_35/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
